requirements_summary: Scale: index 50M+ dense vectors + metadata. Latency: first-pass retrieval P95 <120ms EU region; end-to-end rerank P95 <250ms. Throughput: sustained 200 qps with peaks to 800 qps. SLOs mandatory; fallback routing to secondary EU region on failure.
latency_targets: first-pass P95 <120ms; rerank end-to-end P95 <250ms; tail-latency mitigation required (caching + prefix-KV).
indexing_scale: Target index 50M-150M docs (initial 50M). Must support incremental updates and near-real-time reindexing for trading notes (minutes).
cost_constraints: Preference for predictable monthly committed pricing; target blended cost per query < $0.01 for average rerank workload; willing to trade some latency for cost in non-peak windows.
routing_requirements: Regional routing: primary UK region (London) with warm standby in EU-west (Frankfurt/Amsterdam). Automatic failover with session-aware sticky routing for low latency. Cannot route to US data centers.
